<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Coin Hopper</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
const W = 800, H = 450;

// Each platform: [x, y, width, height] (top-left origin). Enemy patrols between minX and maxX.
const LEVELS = [
  {
    start: [60, 340],
    platforms: [[0, 410, 800, 40], [150, 320, 140, 16], [360, 250, 140, 16], [580, 320, 140, 16], [620, 180, 140, 16]],
    coins: [[220, 285], [430, 215], [650, 285], [690, 145], [500, 375]],
    enemy: { x: 450, y: 385, minX: 330, maxX: 760, speed: 70 },
  },
  {
    start: [40, 340],
    platforms: [[0, 410, 200, 40], [290, 410, 160, 40], [540, 410, 260, 40],
                [200, 320, 90, 16], [330, 250, 110, 16], [500, 190, 110, 16], [660, 270, 110, 16]],
    coins: [[245, 285], [385, 215], [555, 155], [715, 235], [370, 375], [680, 375]],
    enemy: { x: 620, y: 385, minX: 545, maxX: 780, speed: 110 },
  },
];

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Game'); }
  init(data) { this.level = data.level || 0; this.dead = false; }

  makeTextures() {
    const g = this.make.graphics({ add: false });
    const tex = (key, w, h, draw) => {
      if (this.textures.exists(key)) return;
      g.clear(); draw(g); g.generateTexture(key, w, h);
    };
    tex('player', 24, 32, g => { g.fillStyle(0x4aa3ff).fillRect(0, 0, 24, 32); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(14, 6, 6, 6); g.fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(17, 8, 3, 3); });
    tex('coin', 16, 16, g => { g.fillStyle(0xffd400).fillCircle(8, 8, 8); g.fillStyle(0xffef8a).fillCircle(6, 6, 3); });
    tex('enemy', 28, 24, g => { g.fillStyle(0xe5383b).fillRect(0, 0, 28, 24); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5, 6, 6, 6).fillRect(17, 6, 6, 6); g.fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(7, 8, 3, 3).fillRect(19, 8, 3, 3); });
    g.destroy();
  }

  create() {
    this.makeTextures();
    const L = LEVELS[this.level];
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor(this.level ? '#2b1d3a' : '#1d3557');

    this.platforms = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    for (const [x, y, w, h] of L.platforms) {
      const r = this.add.rectangle(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, w, h, this.level ? 0x6d597a : 0x457b9d).setStrokeStyle(2, 0xffffff, 0.4);
      this.physics.add.existing(r, true);
      this.platforms.add(r);
    }

    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(L.start[0], L.start[1], 'player');
    this.player.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, W, H * 2); // allow falling out the bottom
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.jumps = 0;

    this.enemy = this.physics.add.sprite(L.enemy.x, L.enemy.y, 'enemy');
    this.enemy.body.setAllowGravity(true);
    this.enemy.setVelocityX(L.enemy.speed);
    this.enemyCfg = L.enemy;

    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    for (const [x, y] of L.coins) this.coins.create(x, y, 'coin');
    this.total = L.coins.length;
    this.got = 0;

    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.platforms);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.enemy, this.platforms);
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, c) => {
      c.destroy(); this.got++; this.updateHud();
      if (this.got === this.total) this.finishLevel();
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemy, () => this.hitEnemy());

    this.cursors = this.input.keyboard.createCursorKeys();
    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys('W,A,D,SPACE');

    this.hud = this.add.text(12, 10, '', { fontSize: '18px', color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'monospace' });
    this.add.text(W - 12, 10, 'Arrows/AD move · Up/W/Space jump (x2) · stomp the red guy', { fontSize: '12px', color: '#ccc', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(1, 0);
    this.updateHud();
  }

  updateHud() { this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.level + 1}/${LEVELS.length}   Coins ${this.got}/${this.total}`); }

  hitEnemy() {
    if (this.dead || this.won) return;
    const p = this.player.body, e = this.enemy.body;
    if (p.velocity.y > 0 && p.bottom - e.top < 16) { // stomp
      this.enemy.disableBody(true, true);
      this.player.setVelocityY(-350);
      this.jumps = 1;
    } else this.die();
  }

  die() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.player.setTint(0xff0000);
    this.cameras.main.shake(200, 0.01);
    this.time.delayedCall(500, () => this.scene.restart({ level: this.level }));
  }

  finishLevel() {
    this.won = true;
    this.player.setVelocity(0, 0);
    this.add.text(W / 2, H / 2, 'Level clear!', { fontSize: '40px', color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    this.time.delayedCall(900, () => {
      if (this.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) this.scene.restart({ level: this.level + 1 });
      else this.scene.start('Win');
    });
  }

  update() {
    if (this.dead || this.won) return;
    const p = this.player, c = this.cursors, k = this.keys;
    const left = c.left.isDown || k.A.isDown, right = c.right.isDown || k.D.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -190 : right ? 190 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);

    if (p.body.blocked.down) this.jumps = 0;
    const pressed = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(c.up) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.W) || Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(k.SPACE);
    if (pressed) {
      if (p.body.blocked.down) { p.setVelocityY(-420); this.jumps = 1; }
      else if (this.jumps < 2) { p.setVelocityY(-400); this.jumps = 2; }
    }

    if (this.enemy.active) {
      const e = this.enemy, cfg = this.enemyCfg;
      if (e.x <= cfg.minX) e.setVelocityX(cfg.speed);
      else if (e.x >= cfg.maxX) e.setVelocityX(-cfg.speed);
      else if (e.body.velocity.x === 0) e.setVelocityX(cfg.speed);
      e.setFlipX(e.body.velocity.x < 0);
    }

    if (p.y > H + 40) this.die();
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Win'); }
  create() {
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#0b3d2e');
    const t = (y, s, size) => this.add.text(W / 2, y, s, { fontSize: size + 'px', color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    t(170, 'YOU WIN!', 64);
    t(250, 'All coins collected in both levels.', 20);
    const again = t(320, 'Press ENTER or click to play again', 20);
    this.tweens.add({ targets: again, alpha: 0.3, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, duration: 700 });
    const restart = () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 });
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-ENTER', restart);
    this.input.once('pointerdown', restart);
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO,
  width: W, height: H,
  parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 1000 }, debug: false } },
  scene: [Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

    const t = (y, s, size) => this.add.text(W / 2, y, s, { fontSize: size + 'px', color: '#fff', fontFamily: 'monospace' }).setOrigin(0.5);
    t(170, 'YOU WIN!', 64);
    t(250, 'All coins collected in both levels.', 20);
    const again = t(320, 'Press ENTER or click to play again', 20);
    this.tweens.add({ targets: again, alpha: 0.3, yoyo: true, repeat: -1, duration: 700 });
    const restart = () => this.scene.start('Game', { level: 0 });
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-ENTER', restart);
    this.input.once('pointerdown', restart);
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO,
  width: W, height: H,
  parent: document.body,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 1000 }, debug: false } },
  scene: [Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote the game as a single file, `~/work/v5/index.html`, but I haven't run it, so it's untested. Open it in a browser. It loads Phaser 3.80.1 from a CDN, so it needs an internet connection.

- **Controls:** Arrow keys or A/D move. Up, W or Space jump, and you can jump once more in mid-air.
- **Coins:** collect every coin in a level to clear it.
- **Enemy:** one red enemy patrols each level. Landing on top of it kills it, and touching it any other way restarts the level.
- **Falling:** dropping off the bottom of the screen also restarts the level.
- **Levels:** level 2 has gaps in the ground and a faster enemy.
- **Win screen:** it appears after level 2. Press Enter or click to play again.

All the graphics are drawn in code, so there are no image files to load.

The skill listing mentions Phaser 4, but I used 3.80.1 because I'm sure that version exists on the CDN. The code only uses basic features, so it should port to Phaser 4 if you want that.
